column1: # conform/1: the history/1 suite (CONTRACTS.md). One step per line: NAME, INST, REQUEST, EXPECT and an optional SAVE,
# TAB-separated. INST: `a` or `b`, an instance (`henki port history -- PROGRAM`, started on first use); `a!` kills a
# (SIGKILL, no bye), and the next `a` step starts a fresh one; `+V` is a fresh instance offering version V. REQUEST:
# `hello` (the instance's first line) or {"method": M, "params": P}. `@NAME@` is a saved value, `@SCOPE@` and
# `@SCOPE2@` two empty dirs, `@BIG@` 1 MiB of text. EXPECT: the canonical answer line, where `*` is any text and
# `@(A|B)` is A or B; every other character stands for itself. SAVE: NAME=KEY keeps the first string value of "KEY".
# A step whose name ends in a letter prepares the next check; the checks are the names without one. `#cap NAME`: the
# steps after it run only for a binding whose hello lists cap NAME (else they are skipped, with a line saying so).
